instruction: Find and open the page about United's route map and destinations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to their route map and destinations page. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify the URL pattern. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (active_tab_info) extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree, which is the correct state for this navigation task
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) uses regex search to verify URL contains expected pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/where-we-fly'
Expected URL pattern correctly matches the 'route map and destinations' page mentioned in instruction
Complete coverage: single-step navigation task fully verified by checking final URL
Data flow is correct: accessibility tree → URL string → pattern matching → boolean result
No postconfig needed: URL can be read directly from accessibility tree without reopening UI
Runtime execution will work: re.search() will find pattern in full URL like 'https://www.united.com/en/us/fly/travel/where-we-fly'
